description: SYNTHETIC offline fixture for pipeline testing. Every source, value and statement here is invented test data shaped like a reinsurer credit review. None of it is a real-world figure or finding about China Reinsurance (Group) Corporation. Periods are labelled FIXTURE-Y1/Y2 on purpose so they cannot be mistaken for real fiscal years.

sources.title: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Annual report excerpt
sources.notes: Stands in for an issuer annual report. Not a real document.

sources.title: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Rating agency note
sources.notes: Stands in for a rating action commentary. Not a real document.

evidence.statement: Synthetic: the group reports property & casualty reinsurance, life & health reinsurance and primary insurance segments.
Synthetic: a state-owned holding entity is disclosed as the controlling shareholder; the fixture gives no stake percentage.
Synthetic: revenue is disclosed only as domestic versus overseas in aggregate; no country-level split is given.
Synthetic net profit attributable to shareholders, FIXTURE-Y2.
Synthetic P&C reinsurance combined ratio, FIXTURE-Y1.
Synthetic P&C reinsurance combined ratio, FIXTURE-Y2. Left unverified on purpose to exercise the verification gap path.
Synthetic group comprehensive solvency adequacy ratio, FIXTURE-Y2.
Synthetic: the fixture agency affirms its rating with a stable outlook and cites expected support from the controlling shareholder.

findings.statement: In the fixture, revenue grew from 100 to 104 synthetic units between FIXTURE-Y1 and FIXTURE-Y2.
In the fixture, P&C underwriting moved from a small profit to a small loss (combined ratio crossed 100%).
In the fixture, the comprehensive solvency adequacy ratio is 180% in FIXTURE-Y2.
In the fixture, state control and the agency's stated support expectation point the same way.

claims.statement: [Fixture] Regulatory capital sits well above the minimum, partly offsetting weaker underwriting.
claims.caveats: Two fixture periods only; solvency regime comparability not assessed.

claims.statement: [Fixture] Shareholder support is a credit strength cited by the rating agency.
[Fixture] Geographic exposure can only be shown as a domestic/overseas aggregate.

gaps.description: Country-level revenue breakdown is not disclosed in the fixture source; only a domestic/overseas aggregate exists.
gaps.impact: A country-level geography exhibit cannot be produced.
gaps.suggested_action: Show the disclosed aggregate with a disclosure note, or find alternative disclosed data. Do not allocate the overseas share to countries.
